description:
Get real-time water data (streamflow, gage height, temperature) from USGS monitoring sites.
13,000+ stations nationwide. Parameter codes: 00060=discharge (cfs), 00065=gage height (ft), 00010=water temp (°C).
With sites: every reading in the time window (default last day; up to 3 years per request).
With only state_cd: the latest reading at each reporting site in the state (current conditions).

period.description: ISO 8601 duration: 'P1D' (1 day, default), 'P7D' (7 days), 'P30D' (30 days)

state_cd.description: State (code, name, or FIPS) — returns the latest reading per site when sites is omitted

name: usgs_water_data
